Privacy notice

13 October 2026

Who runs this site

Pancratzia is the portfolio of Laura Ortega. For questions about this notice or your inquiry, contact me@pancratzia.com.

Project inquiries

When you contact me by email, I use the information you share to respond to your inquiry and discuss the work you request. Avoid including passwords or sensitive personal information.

External providers

The website is hosted through ChatGPT Sites. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. Google Analytics 4 measures visits and website usage, and Google Tag Manager manages tracking tags. Google may process technical usage information under its own privacy policies. External links to Upwork, Webflow and project websites have their own privacy policies.

Your preferences and requests

The site stores your motion and language preferences locally in your browser. You can contact me to request access to, correction of or deletion of information you submitted. Inquiry information is kept only as needed to handle the request and any resulting project or required business records.
